svg.aria-label: Atlas architecture overview: eight Spring Boot services, each exposed through the API gateway and each validating Keycloak JWTs, communicating over a Kafka event backbone, one PostgreSQL database per service, all exporting metrics, logs and traces to an LGTM observability stack inside a Kubernetes cluster.
